title: Immersed Crafting
description: A Modpack Designed For Extreme Immersion In The Minecraft World
body:
## _Immersed Crafting Is A Modpack Made To Immerse You In The Minecraft World_

**FULLY CLIENT SIDED**

You can use this in any server

Immersed Crafting Features New Third Person And First Person Cameras, Designed To Make The Game Feel More Real

Includes The BSL Shader And Fresh Animations + Fresh Moves To Change Up The Animations To Be Less Stiff

Dynamic Music Slows Down Throughout the Day, And There Are More Realistic Ambient And Footstep Sounds

Built On Optimization Mods, The Pack Runs Very Smoothly To Prevent Lag
